folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B385: structural scope and noncausal measurements
folds.body:
This full checkpoint, every metric row and final receipt were reviewed. F1 preserves the single InventoryComponent/reference identity and key/save ownership while binding its two catalog operations at registration. F2 moves unchanged primitives to their actual owners and retains public re-exports/validation order. F3 snapshots registration metadata and caches dependency order without freezing closure-owned live state or removing late registration/failure handling. World-pack read-only-by-convention Maps and throwing-domain policies differ, so no wrapper or shared sorter is inferred as required.

The measured registry dispatch microbenchmark and independent inventory import closure have their exact bounded populations; neither establishes whole-game speed. Unchanged JSON parsing slowing under higher host load is a confounder, not proof of source regression. Browser PLAY-ready wall time includes automation waiting and hydration. The old full-suite duration difference uses unequal load and two additional lane tests; it cannot be attributed as an engine speedup. Fixture sizes and62 inventory owners are specific synthetic inputs, not a personal-save census.

The one full run passed2878/2879 with a source-stripping harness failure. Its focused7-case repair uses the actual independent ESM module and preserves rollback/private identity/no-reward-replay assertions; it does not turn the historical full run green. The failed IIFE diagnostic and corrected ESM reproduction likewise have distinct meanings. Saved records/schema/validation order remain unchanged under the stated before/after native fixture round trips, without certifying all saves or current integration.

Remaining205 cyclic edges and six main imports are historical debt counts, not a cycle-free graph. Other-owner Person gameplay hunks, generated artifacts and later master integration have separate identities. Old branch commits/merge checks, port5102 and process/worker statements are receipts, not current authorization or live state. AD42 keeps optional human pacing/visual feedback distinct from technical proof. No source graph, runtime, benchmark, build or combined-candidate suite was newly executed here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B385: authority, support timing and scoped documentary proof
folds.body:
The complete checkpoint and the supporting receipt's H1–H8/T1/remaining-scope sections were read. Preserve the distinction between an improved proposed caller and the accepted direction it applies: PRF/FND and the proposed GTR/ABR applications do not become standing because their text was corrected (AD32). Source-header authored costs or a local stamina/wand consumer do not establish franchise law. Event-time public identity/equipment/context differs from what a current observer may now learn retrospectively; permitted hindsight must not silently rewrite an old observation.

T1 specifically traces admission, frozen job context and a completion-time support check. It does not prove continuous enforcement throughout elapsed work. A method losing and regaining support between those boundaries needs a selected invariant and actual implementation evidence before any uninterrupted-support claim. Timed structured abilities use the adapter's refund restriction; a narrower general runtime paid-forfeit branch does not grant every adapter arbitrary cancellation/finish policies. These were source inspections and existing assertions, not fresh passing tests or a demonstrated runtime defect.

Public refusal projects only distinguishable known causes. Known verbs can remain visible with useful reasons without disclosing hidden capabilities/criteria; repeated conversation remains possible through actual contact/language/consciousness and voluntary refusal. Alternate-route costs can be zero when mechanisms support that result, and repeat/overflow/gain follows the actual method, not a universal counter or balancing surcharge. Previously consumed causal bindings stay retained before observation; consequential/changed/conflicting source claims reopen their locators without a second source ledger or blanket reread.

The14-owner/link/locator/retained-line checks establish their bounded documentary properties, not domain conformance or an effect of rules on gameplay. Published repository pointers do not publish separate vault changes. The old sibling status/reservations and released ownership remain dated, with no new UI/source/runtime dispatch. Current AD51 qualifies earlier second-world wording, and AD42 leaves human review optional. No native bug, migration, runtime test, build, browser, personal save or current installed-app behavior was newly verified.
